{{Quote|Okay, watch this. I'll turn these pebbles into sugar leaf taffy.|Teebo entertains the woklings|audio=SugarleafTaffy-Ewoks.flac|<ref name="Horville's Hut of Horrors" />}}
'''Sugar leaf taffy''' was a type of sticky, [[Color/Legends|pink]] [[Taffy (candy)|taffy]] that was [[Diet/Legends|edible]] by [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]].<ref name="Horville's Hut of Horrors" /> In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="EwoksDate">{{EwoksDate|appearance of sugar leaf [[Taffy (candy)|taffy]]|[[Horville's Hut of Horrors (episode)|Horville's Hut of Horrors]]}}</ref> on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]], the Ewok [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]] tried to cheer up a quartet of [[Wokling/Legends|woklings]]&mdash;[[Malani]], [[Nippet/Legends|Nippet]], [[Wiley (Ewok)|Wiley]], and [[Winda Warrick]]&mdash;by using [[Magic/Legends|magic]] to transform pebbles into sugar leaf [[Candy/Legends|taffy]]. As Teebo performed the spell, the pebbles floated into the [[Atmosphere/Legends|air]], expanded, and burst, covering the Ewok's [[Hair/Legends|fur]] with the sticky [[Foodstuff/Legends|confection]]. This delighted the woklings, until Malani noted that Teebo's taffy-covered appearance resembled [[Garth (snake eater)|Garth]], the [[Snake/Legends|snake]] eater at [[Horville's Hut of Horrors]].<ref name="Horville's Hut of Horrors" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sugar leaf taffy appeared in "[[Horville's Hut of Horrors (episode)|Horville's Hut of Horrors]],"<ref name="Horville's Hut of Horrors" /> the sixteenth episode in the [[Ewoks: Season Two|second season]] of the animated television series [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']]. The episode was written by [[Paul Dini]] and premiered on [[November 15]], [[1986]].<ref name="Insider 27">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}</ref>
